handoffs.what: Master loudness. Two RIFT captures with the default settings (master 0.8) integrate to -21.6 / -21.8 LUFS, against the tokens' -18 ± 1.5 and the closing review's -19.0 (that capture still had about 35 heal chimes a minute). The fix is a mix decision: a default master of about 1.0 in session settings (src/session, not CW2), or a +2 dB engine mix trim followed by one more capture.
